violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ARUGULA AT 45F*, FETA AT 45F, BLEU CHEESE AT 44F, AND SHREDDED CHEESE AT 47F IN THE 2-DOOR PREP-TOP (#8); OBSERVED COOKED GROUND BEEF AT 45F, BLACK BEANS AT 44F, RICE AT 44F, SAUSAGE AT 46F, AND DICED TOMATOES AT 45F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS TO ANOTHER COOLER DURING THE INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED THAWING COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED FISH IN THE 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER NEAR THE LEFT SIDE OF THE COOK- LINE IN INTACT PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: PIC SLIT OPEN THE PACKAGING DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THAWING VACUUM PACKAGED FISH ARE REMOVED FROM PACKAGING OF THE PACKAGING IS SLIT OPEN WHEN THE THAWING PROCESS BEGINS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED #8 TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP AT 42- 48F AND THE WALK-IN COOLER AT 40-43F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED OR DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND THE BUILDING ENGINEER CAME TO REPAIR/ADJUST THE COOLERS DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL COOLERS ARE MAINTAINED BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED GRILLED CHICKEN AND GRILLED CHICKEN KABOBS PARTIALLY COOKED IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS DISCUSSED REQUIREMENTS OF NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS WITH PIC. PIC HAS AGREED TO DISCONTINUE PROCESS FOR NOW AND WILL SUBMIT WRITTEN PLANS TO THE HEATLH DEPARTMENT FOR APPROVAL IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WANTS TO CONTINUE THE PROCESS.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS OR DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES.
